events.title: John Cleese turns 87
events.blurb: English actor, comedian, screenwriter, and producer John Cleese, known for Monty Python and Fawlty Towers, celebrates his 87th birthday.

angles.name: Comedy Icon
angles.copy: Wishing a very happy 87th birthday to the legendary John Cleese! From 'Monty Python' to 'Fawlty Towers', his comedic genius is truly timeless.

events.title: The Beatles' 'White Album' released 58 years ago
events.blurb: The Beatles' ninth studio album, officially titled 'The Beatles' but commonly known as the 'White Album', was released on this day in 1968.

angles.name: Iconic Double Album
angles.copy: 58 years since The Beatles unleashed their iconic 'White Album' on the world. A sprawling, diverse masterpiece that still sounds incredible today.

events.title: 35 years since the passing of Freddie Mercury
events.blurb: Today marks 35 years since the death of Queen's iconic frontman, Freddie Mercury, who would have been 80 this year.

angles.name: Legendary Voice
angles.copy: Remembering the incomparable Freddie Mercury, 35 years since we lost his extraordinary talent. His voice and stage presence remain legendary.

events.title: The Beatles' 'Rubber Soul' released 61 years ago
events.blurb: The Beatles' sixth studio album, 'Rubber Soul', was released on this day in 1965, marking a pivotal moment in their artistic evolution.

angles.name: Revolutionary Album
angles.copy: 61 years ago, The Beatles' 'Rubber Soul' arrived, pushing boundaries and setting new standards for pop music. A true game-changer.

events.title: 46 years since the passing of John Lennon
events.blurb: Today marks 46 years since the tragic death of The Beatles' co-founder, John Lennon, who would have been 86 this year.

angles.name: Peace & Music
angles.copy: Remembering John Lennon, 46 years on. His music and message of peace continue to resonate globally.

events.title: David Bowie would have been 80
events.blurb: The visionary musician, David Bowie, who passed away in 2016, would have celebrated his 80th birthday today.

angles.name: Starman's Legacy
angles.copy: Remembering the iconic David Bowie on what would have been his 80th birthday. A true innovator whose influence is still felt across music and culture.

events.title: Elvis Presley would have been 92
events.blurb: The King of Rock and Roll, Elvis Presley, who passed away in 1977, would have celebrated his 92nd birthday today.

angles.name: The King Lives On
angles.copy: On what would have been his 92nd birthday, we celebrate the enduring legacy of Elvis Presley. The King still reigns!

events.title: Jimmy Page turns 83
events.blurb: Legendary Led Zeppelin guitarist and songwriter Jimmy Page celebrates his 83rd birthday today.

angles.name: Guitar God
angles.copy: Happy 83rd birthday to the incomparable Jimmy Page! His riffs with Led Zeppelin redefined rock guitar.

events.title: Rod Stewart turns 82
events.blurb: British rock and pop icon Sir Rod Stewart celebrates his 82nd birthday today.

angles.name: Forever Young
angles.copy: Raise a glass to Sir Rod Stewart, who turns 82 today! Still rocking after all these years.

events.title: Suggs (Madness) turns 66
events.blurb: Graham McPherson, better known as Suggs, the lead singer of British ska band Madness, celebrates his 66th birthday.

angles.name: Nutty Boy's Day
angles.copy: Happy 66th birthday to Suggs, the iconic frontman of Madness! Still bringing the house of fun.

events.title: Paul Young turns 71
events.blurb: English singer-songwriter Paul Young, known for his 80s hits, celebrates his 71st birthday today.

angles.name: Wherever He Lays His Hat
angles.copy: Wishing a very happy 71st birthday to the smooth-voiced Paul Young! Still loving his classic 80s tracks.

events.title: Dolly Parton would have been 81
events.blurb: The legendary country music singer-songwriter Dolly Parton, who passed away in 2026, would have celebrated her 81st birthday today.

angles.name: Queen of Country
angles.copy: Remembering the one and only Dolly Parton on what would have been her 81st birthday. Her music and spirit shine on.

events.title: Gary Barlow turns 56
events.blurb: Take That lead singer and songwriter Gary Barlow celebrates his 56th birthday today.

angles.name: Take That Legend
angles.copy: Happy 56th birthday to the brilliant Gary Barlow! From Take That hits to his solo success, a true British music icon.

events.title: Billy Ocean turns 77
events.blurb: Trinidadian-British singer Billy Ocean, known for his string of 70s and 80s R&B and pop hits, celebrates his 77th birthday.

angles.name: Caribbean Queen
angles.copy: Wishing a fantastic 77th birthday to the one and only Billy Ocean! His soulful voice still gets us dancing.

events.title: First Rock and Roll Hall of Fame induction 38 years ago
events.blurb: On this day in 1989, the Rock and Roll Hall of Fame held its inaugural induction ceremony, honouring pioneers of music.

angles.name: History Made
angles.copy: 38 years ago, music history was made with the very first Rock and Roll Hall of Fame induction ceremony. Who were your favourite inaugural inductees?

events.title: Mark Owen turns 55
events.blurb: Take That member Mark Owen celebrates his 55th birthday today.

angles.name: Take That Star
angles.copy: Happy 55th birthday to Mark Owen! Celebrating the Take That star's special day.
